text.original: Learn about Cornerstone Commercial Realty, a Chicago commercial brokerage built on underwriting discipline and submarket depth since 2008.
Built on underwriting discipline, not sentiment

Cornerstone Commercial Realty was founded in 2008 by Daniel Marsh, a capital markets broker who launched the firm in the middle of a financial crisis on one conviction: commercial real estate decisions should be driven by data and comparable transactions, not by sentiment or relationships alone. That discipline shaped how the firm was built from day one.

Eighteen years later, our team of brokers has represented more than 310 properties and transacted over 42 million square feet of office, retail, and industrial space across Chicago and the collar suburbs. We remain independently owned, with every broker specializing in a specific submarket rather than covering the entire region at once.
Today, Cornerstone is known for rigorous market analysis, straightforward fee structures, and a team that stays engaged with clients well past lease signing or closing day.
Every recommendation is backed by comparable-sale data and rent-roll analysis, not gut instinct.
Each broker specializes in specific Chicagoland submarkets and asset classes, not the whole map at once.
We measure success by lease renewals and repeat mandates, not single transactions.
Cornerstone supports Chicago small-business development and workforce training initiatives.

What lease structures do you typically negotiate?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Most Chicagoland office and retail leases are structured as full-service gross or modified gross, while industrial space is typically triple net (NNN). We'll walk through the difference and model total occupancy cost for any structure during your consultation.
How are broker fees and commissions structured?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: In most leasing transactions, commission is paid by the landlord as part of the deal, so tenant representation carries no direct cost to you. Investment sales commissions are negotiated per engagement and disclosed up front — there are never hidden fees.
How long does a typical transaction take to close?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: A straightforward office or retail lease typically takes 60-90 days from site selection to occupancy. Investment sales usually run 90-150 days depending on financing and due diligence complexity.
Which Chicago-area submarkets do you cover?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: We cover the Loop, West Loop, River North, and greater Chicagoland, including the O'Hare industrial corridor, Schaumburg, Naperville, and the surrounding collar suburbs.
Is there a minimum deal size for investment sales representation?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: We typically represent investment sales starting around $1.5 million, with our team most active in the $3 million to $25 million range. Reach out regardless of size — we can point you in the right direction even outside that band.
Book a free consultation and we'll help you determine the right next step for your business.

text.original: O'Hare Corridor Distribution Center, Elk Grove Village | Cornerstone Commercial Realty
2200 Touhy Ave, Elk Grove Village, IL — 84,000 SF Class B distribution facility for lease, listed by Cornerstone Commercial Realty.
2200 Touhy Avenue, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007

Located minutes from O'Hare International Airport and I-90 in the heart of the Elk Grove Village industrial corridor, this 84,000-square-foot distribution facility offers 32-foot clear heights, ESFR sprinklers, and heavy power for logistics, light manufacturing, or last-mile distribution use. The building includes 4,200 square feet of built-out office space with a conference room and private offices, and the fully fenced, secured yard accommodates trailer parking and container storage. Zoned I-1 Limited Industrial, the property is available for direct lease with occupancy available within 60 days.
